text.arabic_uthmani: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: interrogative opening that creates an open respondent slot with conditional-like breadth
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the ayah as a search for a respondent, not as a report about a named person. Its interrogative force recruits a willing agent, while its open scope leaves the invitation available to whoever can answer through the lending act. As the first layer in the three-word pointing sequence, it lets the agent slot be built before the lending verb arrives.

topics.headline: open question recruits a respondent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by making the audience supply an agent rather than by issuing a bare command.
topics.reason: QAC parses the word as an interrogative particle and attachment evidence makes it the opening subject of the nominal question; the CRITICAL rows coherently read the opening as an exhortive recruitment frame.

topics.headline: first layer in a stacked reference chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word is part of a three-word pointing sequence that delays the action until the lender is rhetorically built.
topics.reason: The separate word position before {{ar:ذَا}} ({{tr:dhā}}) and {{ar:ٱلَّذِي}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) supports the CRITICAL claim that the opening stacks reference before the verb arrives.

words.gloss_range: demonstrative middle layer that gives the unnamed respondent deictic presence
words.prose: {{ar:ذَا}} ({{tr:dhā}}) points into the open respondent slot, making the still-unnamed lender feel present and summonable before the relative clause defines him. Whether taken as predicate or reinforcing element, it keeps the opening from becoming a flat relative phrase. It is also the middle link in the recurring three-part divine-loan challenge formula (2:245, 2:261, 64:17).

topics.headline: demonstrative makes the respondent present
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pointing toward a possible respondent before naming the action that defines him.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support a demonstrative or appositional role in the opening clause, and the CRITICAL rows make that deictic pressure reader-facing.

topics.headline: middle link in the challenge formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word as the central link in a known three-part challenge formula rather than as a disposable filler.
topics.reason: The separate demonstrative sits between the interrogative and relative pronoun, matching the CRITICAL rows that identify a stacked challenge sequence.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun that turns the open question into identity-by-action
words.prose: {{ar:الَّذِي}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) binds the open question to the following lending clause. The respondent is not identified by class or title; he becomes identifiable by the act expressed next. As the third referential layer, it suspends the listener until the delayed verb lands as the definition of the one being sought.

topics.headline: relative pronoun selects by action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the agent's identity is created by the following action, not assumed beforehand.
topics.reason: QAC marks a relative pronoun and attachment evidence makes the following clause its defining relative clause; the CRITICAL rows align with this syntax.

topics.headline: third reference layer delays the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the opening build expectation through three referential words before the lending action finally arrives.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the third adjacent referential item and requires a following clause, so the CRITICAL suspense claim is structurally licensed.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active imperfect lending as an available voluntary act in the challenge frame
words.root_gloss_range: loan and transfer are locally selected; cutting, severance, poetic shaping, borrowing, and extinction remain narrowed background pressures
words.prose: {{ar:يُقْرِضُ}} ({{tr:yuqriḍu}}) is the verb that finally fills the respondent slot: an active, singular, imperfect Form IV act of lending, not a direct imperative. The grammar makes God the direct object of the loan, while the {{ar:ق ر ض}} ({{tr:q-r-ḍ}}) field keeps a narrowed image of a severed portion transferred with return expected; remote cutting, poetry, borrowing, and extinction branches remain background, not the local sense. The loan-to-God formula also links this challenge with 2:245, 64:17, 73:20, and the same-surah answer in 57:18.

topics.headline: active imperfect makes lending available
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices voluntary agency: the ayah asks who will perform the act rather than commanding a named group.
topics.reason: QAC confirms Form IV imperfect indicative active with singular agreement controlled by the relative pronoun.

topics.headline: God enters the borrower-position
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the paradox that God is grammatically placed as the recipient of what the human offers.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:اللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) as the direct object and {{ar:قَرْضًا}} ({{tr:qarḍan}}) as the cognate accusative, preserving the transactional paradox.

topics.headline: severed-portion image is locally narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the loan feels like parting with a portion, which prepares the reversal when that portion is multiplied.
topics.reason: The local Form IV and object frame select lending, so cutting, poetic shaping, borrowing, and extinction can color the transfer only as narrowed root-image background.

topics.headline: specialized divine-loan formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this as part of a recurring divine-loan challenge, with 57:18 answering the question as a realized class.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete references and the contextual profiles support a specialized divine-loan construction.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in accusative direct-object position
words.root_gloss_range: divine proper-name field with worship, seeking, and disputed love/bewilderment pressures; local grammar selects the named divine recipient without implying need
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) is accusative as the direct object of the lending verb, so the grammar places God in recipient position while the wider context prevents any idea that God benefits from the loan. The proper name makes the transaction unique, and its position between the lending verb and the cognate loan-object puts the divine recipient at the center of the formula. The next clause then restores divine agency as the one who multiplies. The derivational dispute around {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) and worship/seeking language can enrich the divine-name field, but it remains narrowed under the local proper-name role.

topics.headline: God is the grammatical recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the deliberate paradox that the absolute giver is syntactically treated as the one lent to.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both mark the divine name as accusative direct object of the lending verb.

topics.headline: recipient role does not imply divine benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps separate the grammar of recipienthood from the benefit, which is routed back to the lender.
topics.reason: The later beneficiary pronouns point to the lender while the multiplication verb has God as recoverable subject, so the CRITICAL distinction is supported.

topics.headline: proper name narrows devotional root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the loan is not to a generic recipient but to the named God, with devotional force rather than ordinary need.
topics.reason: The proper noun form licenses divine-name specificity; disputed derivational pressures are useful only as narrowed background and cannot replace the local proper-name syntax.

topics.headline: divine name centers the loan formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the divine name positioned between verb and loan-object as the center of the formula.
topics.reason: The word sits between the lending verb and the cognate accusative, and the contextual profiles support recurrence of the divine-loan formula.

words.gloss_range: indefinite cognate accusative naming and intensifying the loan act/object
words.root_gloss_range: loan, transferred object, recompense, and severed-portion imagery are locally relevant; remote branches remain narrowed under the cognate accusative construction
words.prose: {{ar:قَرْضًا}} ({{tr:qarḍan}}) repeats the lending root as a cognate accusative, so the first beat intensifies the act itself before the result begins. Its indefinite form leaves the amount unnamed, while the following adjective supplies the quality limit. The word also keeps the loan as both action and transferred object, a severed portion that is immediately routed toward multiplication and reward; the recurring phrase appears in 2:245, 5:12, 57:18, 64:17, and 73:20.

topics.headline: cognate accusative intensifies lending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not merely say lend, but reinforces the act with its own verbal noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly marks the word as a cognate accusative governed by the lending verb.

topics.headline: unspecified loan is defined by quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the amount remains open while the required quality is grammatically locked to the loan.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative indefinite and the following adjective agrees with it, so quality rather than named quantity defines the phrase.

topics.headline: severed loan becomes returnable object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the given portion as the very object that can be multiplied back, not as a vanished loss.
topics.reason: The masdar form and later object suffix support action/object continuity, while recompense and severance imagery must remain narrowed to the local loan frame.

topics.headline: formulaic goodly-loan phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the noun phrase as a specialized Quranic loan formula that reframes outgoing spending as returnable.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete formula references and the local phrase matches the attachment-confirmed loan plus adjective unit.

words.gloss_range: accusative indefinite adjective making excellence the condition of the loan
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, goodness, approval, and excellence-in-action color the loan; feigned beauty remains a narrowed contrast

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causal connector following the qualified loan
final noble reward quality answering the loan's quality

words.prose: {{ar:حَسَنًا}} ({{tr:ḥasanan}}) agrees with the loan noun, so goodness is attached to the act/object itself rather than floating as a general moral aside. The {{ar:ح س ن}} ({{tr:ḥ-s-n}}) field makes the requirement qualitative: beautiful, morally good, and well-executed, with feigned beauty only a narrowed shadow contrast. Positioned before {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), it closes the human side of the exchange before multiplication begins and later pairs with {{ar:كَرِيمٌ}} ({{tr:karīmun}}) as a quality bookend.

topics.headline: quality is grammatically attached to the loan
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that excellence is a condition on the loan itself, not an optional mood around giving.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks adjective agreement with {{ar:قَرْضًا}} ({{tr:qarḍan}}), and QAC confirms its adjectival role.

topics.headline: goodness field becomes real loan quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the loan's quality as beauty, goodness, and excellence in execution, while mere display is excluded.
topics.reason: The broader root family enriches the adjective, but local adjective agreement narrows the field to real quality of the loan rather than separate abstract virtue or feigned appearance.

topics.headline: quality closes the first beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the human act closes on quality before divine multiplication and noble reward answer it.
topics.reason: The word stands at the end of the loan phrase before the causal connector, and the CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah and formulaic echoes.

words.gloss_range: causal and sequential connector fused to the multiplication result
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from the completed good loan into its result. Its causal force makes multiplication the consequence of the loan, while its attached form makes the transition immediate and keeps the following verbal response distinct from the later added reward clause.

topics.headline: causal connector creates consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that multiplication is grammatically tied to the loan as consequence, not loosely appended.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a causal result clause after the loan phrase.

topics.headline: attached form makes the turn immediate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees and hears the result connector fused to the multiplying verb at the agency shift.
topics.reason: The particle is a proclitic on the following verb, supporting the CRITICAL claim of immediate written and audible transition.

topics.headline: first response stays distinct from reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah first gives causal multiplication, then adds a separate reward with a different connector.
topics.reason: The result clause opened here is followed by a coordinated nominal clause, matching the CRITICAL two-response structure.

words.gloss_range: active multiplication verb with attached object pronoun resuming the loan
words.root_gloss_range: multiplication is locally selected; weakness, weakening, and self-multiplication remain narrowed contrastive pressures

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causal connector governing the multiplication result

words.prose: {{ar:يُضَاعِفَهُ}} ({{tr:yuḍāʿifahu}}) carries the first divine response: God, recoverable as subject, actively multiplies the loan carried by the attached object pronoun. The standard subjunctive after {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes this multiplication dependent on the loan, while accepted variant moods and stems show how much pressure sits at this verb: consequence versus assertion, Form III extension versus Form II intensification. The {{ar:ض ع ف}} ({{tr:ḍ-ʿ-f}}) field keeps weakness as a narrowed contrast, because the local form turns apparent deficiency into increase. Unlike 2:245, this wording leaves the multiplication unquantified, and 57:18 echoes the same return pattern for the plural lenders.

topics.headline: active multiplication depends on the loan
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices multiplication as God's active consequence to the lending act, not an independent financial mechanism.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as subjunctive after causal {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), active, with God as the recoverable subject.

topics.headline: attached object keeps the loan present
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the thing given, not merely the giver's status, is what the verb carries forward and multiplies.
topics.reason: Attachment and referent evidence identify the suffix as the verb's object and link it to the loan or lending act just mentioned.

topics.headline: weakness field reverses into increase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a lexical reversal: what might look small or depleted becomes the site of multiplied increase.
topics.reason: The local Form III multiplication sense controls the word, so weakness and weakening branches survive only as contrastive root pressure.

topics.headline: variant forms expose pressure at the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mood and stem variants change whether multiplication sounds more dependent, asserted, extended, or intensive.
topics.reason: Accepted variants are valid contrastive evidence, but the canonical local parse remains the subjunctive Form III reading.

topics.headline: open-ended multiplication formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this multiplication as a formulaic divine return that remains unquantified here and is echoed in 57:18.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete parallels and the local wording omits the explicit quantifier found in 2:245.

words.gloss_range: benefactive preposition plus singular pronoun routing multiplication back to the lender

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fronted beneficiary predicate opening the reward clause

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) routes the multiplied loan back to the one who lent. Its singular suffix keeps the return individualized from the opening respondent, and its position after the multiplication verb separates what is multiplied from for whom it is multiplied. This first benefit marker also prepares the repeated {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) that will introduce the reward clause.

topics.headline: benefit is routed to the lender
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God is the loan recipient grammatically, but the benefit is explicitly for the lender.
topics.reason: Referent evidence links the suffix to the interrogative lender, and attachment evidence makes the prepositional phrase the beneficiary complement of multiplication.

topics.headline: compact singular form individualizes return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the open invitation become a personally assigned return for the singular respondent.
topics.reason: The lām plus singular suffix form compresses beneficiary and direction, and the word order places it after the multiplied object.

topics.headline: first benefit marker anticipates the second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears two returns to the same beneficiary being prepared: multiplication first, reward next.
topics.reason: The same bound form recurs at word 12 with the same referent, while the clauses differ syntactically.

words.gloss_range: additive connector opening a separate nominal reward clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fronted beneficiary predicate opening the reward clause

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) starts a new promised unit after the causal multiplication clause. It links without collapsing: the first response is dynamic multiplication, while the added clause gives stable possession of reward. Because the conjunction attaches directly to {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}), the added promise begins again from the beneficiary.

topics.headline: connector opens a separate reward clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reward is not merely another name for multiplication; it is added in a new nominal clause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks a coordinated nominal clause after the result clause, supporting separate reward predication.

topics.headline: addition preserves two response types
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the ayah's two divine responses distinct: multiplied object and possessed reward.
topics.reason: The connector links clauses with different predicate types, matching the CRITICAL contrast between verbal and nominal response.

topics.headline: soft restart begins with beneficiary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final clause restart gently by returning first to the same beneficiary.
topics.reason: The conjunction is proclitic on the fronted prepositional predicate, making the new promise recipient-focused from its first sound.

words.gloss_range: fronted possessive-benefactive predicate assigning the reward to the same lender
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) is fronted as the predicate of the reward clause, so the clause first assigns possession before naming the reward. It repeats the earlier benefit marker but changes frame: word 10 routes multiplication through a verb, while this word establishes reward as something stably for the same lender.

topics.headline: fronting assigns reward first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause foregrounds who the reward is for before the reward is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the prepositional phrase as the preposed predicate with the reward noun as delayed subject.

topics.headline: benefit becomes stable possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the return move from directional benefit to an assigned reward that belongs to the lender.
topics.reason: The nominal possession frame and referent evidence assign the reward to the same lender and exclude God as beneficiary.

topics.headline: repeated marker builds two-channel return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one beneficiary carried through two grammatical frames: multiplied loan and possessed reward.
topics.reason: The same lām-plus-pronoun form recurs with the same referent while changing syntactic role.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative reward noun standing as delayed subject of the possession clause
words.root_gloss_range: wage, compensation, recompense, and ethical reward are locally active as a structured reward field
words.prose: {{ar:أَجْرٌ}} ({{tr:ajrun}}) stands as the delayed nominative subject of the possession clause, so the reward is presented as an assigned reality rather than another action. Its indefinite verbal-noun form leaves the scale open, while the {{ar:أ ج ر}} ({{tr:ʾ-j-r}}) field brings wage, compensation, and ethical recompense into the closing promise. This reward is distinct from the multiplied loan-object and joins the same-surah reward thread in 57:7, 57:18, 57:19, and 57:27; the singular formula in 57:11 returns as a plural formula in 57:18.

topics.headline: reward stands as delayed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on stable possession of reward, not merely ongoing multiplication.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the word as nominative delayed subject in the final nominal clause.

topics.headline: indefinite form leaves reward open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward as unmeasured and open-ended rather than as a fixed listed payment.
topics.reason: The singular indefinite verbal noun supports open category and magnitude without specifying procedure or amount.

topics.headline: recompense is separate from the multiplied loan
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final reward is an additional recompense, not the same thing as the multiplied object.
topics.reason: The wage and recompense field is locally apt after the loan metaphor, but it is narrowed by the nominal reward clause and distinguished from the earlier object suffix.

topics.headline: same-surah noble reward formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the singular promise in 57:11 as part of a larger same-surah compensation thread fulfilled in plural form in 57:18.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah references and the local phrase matches the reward formula with the following adjective.

words.gloss_range: nominative indefinite qualitative adjective making nobility intrinsic to the reward
words.root_gloss_range: nobility, generosity, preciousness, honoring, and life-giving abundance color the reward; local grammar binds them to the reward phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: reward noun qualified by the final adjective
earlier quality adjective qualifying the human loan

words.prose: {{ar:كَرِيمٌ}} ({{tr:karīmun}}) agrees with {{ar:أَجْرٌ}} ({{tr:ajrun}}), so nobility belongs to the reward itself and does not drift back to the lender or the loan. Its indefinite adjective form leaves that nobility unmeasured, and the {{ar:ك ر م}} ({{tr:k-r-m}}) field makes the reward generous, precious, and ennobling rather than merely a counted repayment. As the final word, it moves the ayah's closure from quantity to quality and answers the earlier {{ar:حَسَنًا}} ({{tr:ḥasanan}}) with a higher reward-quality; the formula recurs in 57:18.

topics.headline: nobility belongs to the reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final quality is grammatically a property of the reward itself.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the word as an agreeing adjective of the reward noun.

topics.headline: indefinite adjective leaves nobility open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward's quality as unquantified and open, not reduced to a measurable bonus.
topics.reason: The adjective is nominative and indefinite like the reward noun, supporting open-ended qualitative magnification.

topics.headline: generosity field ennobles recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward exceeds ordinary compensation by carrying dignity, generosity, and honor.
topics.reason: The broader root field enriches the adjective, while local agreement narrows every branch to the reward's quality.

topics.headline: final quality answers first quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's economy framed by quality: good human loan answered by noble divine reward.
topics.reason: The word closes the ayah and the CRITICAL rows connect it to the earlier quality adjective and to the same-surah reward formula in 57:18.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated q-r-d at words 4 and 6 is qualified by hasan at 7 and followed by multiplication, compensation, and karim at 8, 11, and 12.
baseline_models.mechanism: A giver cuts a good portion from present possession as a return-bearing advance; God adds equivalents and returns compensation whose generosity and honor exceed bare settlement.

activation_trace.role: A cut of wealth or work awaiting recompense supplies the advance-and-return structure.
Beneficence and increase beyond strict justice make the loan's quality active rather than decorative.
Adding one or more equivalents supplies the expansion of the detached portion.
Compensation for work or contract gives the expanded return a recompense register.
Honored generosity marks the recompense as more than an exact discharge.

changed_reading.after: The giver deliberately detaches a good portion, and God converts it into compounded, honor-bearing recompense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Q-r-d at words 4 and 6 also carries a trading-capital branch, while words 8 and 12 name expansion and a gift seeking recompense.
baseline_models.mechanism: The loan can be carried as an entrusted venture: capital leaves immediate control, enters an unseen productive relation, and returns with enlarged yield rather than merely the same principal.

activation_trace.role: Trading capital entrusted to an operator with conditioned profit supplies the venture structure.
Increase by equivalents supplies yield beyond preservation of principal.
A gift offered in hope of recompense keeps expected return inside a generous gift relation.

changed_reading.before: The loan is a static debt entry.
changed_reading.after: The relinquished portion behaves like entrusted capital whose divine yield enlarges what returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expenditure comes from wealth in which people have succeeded others; all inheritance returns to God, who is self-sufficient. The loan therefore releases entrusted possession rather than supplying a needy borrower.

activation_trace.role: The return-bearing cut remains the focus mechanism being revised.
Money going out in expenditure identifies the concrete release enacted by the loan.
One holder coming after another and taking the prior one's place makes possession successive and temporary.
Inheritance passing from a predecessor to an heir places all holdings inside an eventual transfer back to God.
Self-sufficiency blocks any reading in which God needs the advanced property.

structural_cues: 57:7 places spending inside succession, 57:10 names God's inheritance, and 57:24 opposes miserliness with divine self-sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expenditure, successive holding, divine inheritance, and self-sufficiency; I infer stewardship and non-need. A live alternative is that these are separate exhortations without a technical ownership model.

changed_reading.before: A person lends privately owned wealth to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: A temporary holder releases part of an entrusted estate to the One who needs nothing; the loan figure guarantees return while undoing possessiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The comparison between expenditure before and after the opening makes timing and exposure affect rank. This sharpens the venture branch: equal outlays are not equal when one leaves control before success is visible.

activation_trace.role: Entrusted trading capital supplies the focus model whose exposure is being weighted.
Beneficent excellence lets 'good' include how and when the advance is made.
Repeated outgoing expenditure supplies the common act on both sides of the timing comparison.
The opening of victory marks the threshold after which the outcome is less exposed.
Taking rank degree by degree supplies differentiated valuation rather than flat equivalence.

structural_cues: 57:10 explicitly contrasts before and after the opening, assigns the earlier giver a greater degree, yet promises good to both.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unequal degree for the same kind of spending across a visible threshold; I infer exposure-sensitive value. The alternative is chronology of obedience without any venture-risk analogy.

changed_reading.before: Any equal principal counts as the same good loan.
changed_reading.after: The loan's goodness can include early relinquishment under uncertainty, so timing and exposure shape its yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the loan, believers possess moving light; others later seek to take light from them but meet a wall, and no substitute is accepted. The advanced portion is thus readable as transformed into person-bound future capacity rather than transferable credit.

activation_trace.role: The present cut made for future return supplies the asset-conversion starting point.
Light actively moving with believers supplies a realized, usable form of return.
Light or good sought from another tests whether this realized return can be acquired secondhand.
An enclosing elevated wall makes the failure of late transfer spatially irreversible.
Substituting one thing as ransom for another is denied, closing a second route to post hoc purchase.

structural_cues: 57:12-15 moves from each believer's light to a failed request for borrowed light, a separating wall, and rejected ransom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, possessed light, failed acquisition, a barrier, and rejected substitution; I infer that the loan's return has become person-bound light. The alternative is simple juxtaposition of independent eschatological outcomes.

changed_reading.before: The multiplied return is an abstract future balance.
changed_reading.after: Present relinquishment becomes one's own future light and mobility, a return that cannot be borrowed or bought after the boundary closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later near-verbatim formula is attached to male and female charity-givers, and the next ayah pairs reward with their light. The singular challenge becomes an enacted, gender-inclusive class whose released wealth has visible future effect.

activation_trace.role: Charity of wealth and right identifies the concrete practice and explicitly includes masculine and feminine agents.
The repeated return-bearing cut binds that charity cohort directly to the focus loan formula.
Their light places a visible future correlate beside their reward.

structural_cues: 57:18 repeats the focus sequence through multiplied noble reward while replacing the open singular question with named male and female agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula, charity morphology, both genders, and adjacent reward/light; I infer functional continuity. A live alternative is that charity and qard remain adjacent but distinct acts.

changed_reading.before: The question addresses an exceptional, unspecified individual lender.
changed_reading.after: The invitation names a repeatable charity practice embodied by both women and men, with reward becoming visible as their own light.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two prepared shares of mercy, light for walking, forgiveness, and favor held and given by God unpack multiplication as a bundle of enabling gifts. Return remains real, but it exceeds an enforceable cash analogue.

activation_trace.role: Increase by equivalent or more supplies the focus promise being concretized.
A carried share or prepared equivalent, here doubled, gives multiplication a distributable form.
Illumination turns part of the return into guidance and visibility.
Walking and movement make the light operational rather than merely ornamental.
Benefaction and gift place the surplus return in God's giving rather than the lender's power to collect.

structural_cues: 57:28 sequences two mercy shares, light, movement, and forgiveness; 57:29 repeats that favor is in God's hand and given as God wills.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies doubled shares and a gift bundle under divine disposal; I infer these as an unpacking of multiplied recompense. The alternative is that the closing promises are parallel benefits unrelated to the loan image.

changed_reading.before: Multiplication means a larger quantity of the same thing lent.
changed_reading.after: Multiplication returns as surplus mercy, usable light, forgiveness, and favor: transformed benefits granted beyond principal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the plant-and-rain branch of karim rather than its usual honor branch. It remains valid because focus qard supplies separation, focus karim supplies crop quality, and the context supplies revived earth and a crop's decay. Render it only as a secondary material analogy, not as a replacement gloss for karim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The cut of q-r-d at words 4 and 6 and the plant/rain quality branch of k-r-m at word 12 anchor a counter-harvest model.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and separating supplies the material departure of the portion from the giver's possession.
Quality in vegetation and rain opens an agricultural image for the noble return.
Earth living through rain and vegetation supplies regenerative growth after apparent loss.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the visible yield stage.
Yellowing and drying of vegetation marks the failure of merely worldly yield to endure.
The world's vanishing debris supplies the negative harvest against which the multiplied return stands.

changed_reading.before: The loan and reward belong only to legal-financial exchange.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the detached portion enters a counter-harvest: worldly growth dries into debris, while divine multiplication yields enduring karim quality.

strongest_changes: The borrower image is reversed by succession, divine inheritance, and self-sufficiency: the giver releases entrusted wealth rather than meeting divine need.
The return becomes person-bound light that cannot be acquired, transferred, or substituted after the separating boundary.
Later doubled shares, light, movement, forgiveness, and favor unpack multiplication as transformed surplus rather than more of the same asset.
summary.what_was_special: The surrounding sequence repeatedly converts a financial metaphor into temporal exposure, embodied charity, non-transferable light, and divine surplus while preserving the focus's cut-return-compensation chain.
remaining_uncertainties: The before/after-opening distinction may rank obedience by chronology without implying venture exposure.
The light sequence may be juxtaposed consequence rather than a direct transformation of the loan's return.
The counter-harvest depends on a less usual karim branch and should remain exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The loan is a deliberate cutting-away from present possession.** ق ر ض B001 is cutting off and clipping remnants; B003 is a repayable cut-off advance. The causative sequence **فيضاعفه** follows the separation. The packet supplies cutting-away then return; I infer relinquished control -> availability for multiplication. The “loan” reads as a real severance from present use, not a costless accounting fiction.
2. **Multiplication is equal addition that alters the original scale.** ض ع ف B002 is adding an equal amount, while ك ر م B010 is a dear or highly valued thing and B001 praiseworthy generosity. The packet supplies duplication and valued recompense; I infer repeated equal addition -> transformed magnitude and quality. The response is not merely repayment but a generous revaluation of what was cut away.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:18 repeats the entire loan mechanism after identifying charitable actors, confirming that the metaphor attaches to concrete release. 57:28’s **كفلين** supplies another doubled allotment, making multiplication a recurring architecture of return.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The loan begins by cutting a portion away.** Repeated `ق ر ض` **B001** supplies cutting off, and **B003** supplies a repayable cut-off advance that awaits recompense. Expenditure immediately precedes in 57:10, while the wall of 57:13 and the absence of later ransom in 57:15 make timing consequential. The packet supplies the cut, promised return, and later closure; I infer that the lender must detach a portion from present control before seeing the other side. The “loan” thus reads as a real severance now, not a costless metaphor.
2. **Multiplication as fertile expansion.** `ض ع ف` **B002** supplies adding an equal amount and **B005** an estate becoming widespread and abundant; `ك ر م` **B002** supplies good growth and rain-bearing bounty. The next ayah presents covered gardens and continuing rivers. The packet supplies multiplication, abundance, and fertile reward; I infer the causal growth arrow. Repayment therefore reads as an advance made organically expansive, not merely an arithmetic duplicate.
3. **Goodness includes expenditure at the limit.** Dormant `ح س ن` **B005** supplies one's utmost effort or limit, alongside **B001** goodness. Spending before the opening in 57:10, self-testing and delay in 57:14, and the question of whether the due time has arrived in 57:16 make the temporal pressure visible. I infer that “good” describes a loan whose timing reaches the lender's practical limit. The phrase can therefore register costly quality, not only moral pleasantness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:12's covered gardens and flowing provision made `ك ر م` **B002** and `ض ع ف` **B005** read as fertile expansion rather than abstract multiplication. The failed late substitute in 57:15 and due-time question in 57:16 corrected the loan toward timely severance, strengthening `ق ر ض` **B001**.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya şeyin güzel ve beğenilir olması, çirkinliğin karşıtı olan temel anlamdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalın ve sınırsız bir içlik anlamı vermez; kitabın satır araları veya kenarı ile bedenin kemikleri, organları ve iç boşluğu için kullanılan belirli anlatımları yan yana getirir. Dal korunabilir, ancak genel bir iç veya orta anlamı gibi değil, bu sözlüksel olarak sınırlı yer bildirimlerinin kümesi olarak tanımlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca kitap ve bedenle ilgili kayıtlı kullanımlara bağlıdır; her nesnenin içi, ortası veya kenarı için genellenemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Biçim ve ad öbeklerine bağlı kitap ile beden anlamları ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur; bunlardan bağımsız bir yalın içlik anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kullanımlarda bir kitabın satır aralarını veya kenarını, bir bedenin ise kemiklerini, organlarını ya da iç boşluğunu gösteren yer bildirimidir. Bu alanlar ortak bir yalın iç anlamına genellenmez.

facets.statement: Kitapla birlikte kullanıldığında satırların arasındaki alanı veya sayfa kenarını bildirir.
Bedenle birlikte kullanıldığında kemikleri veya organları gösterebilir.
Beden bağlamındaki bir başka kullanım, iç boşluğu veya bedenin iç kısmını gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kayıt, kitap bağlamında satır arası ile kenarı; beden bağlamında ise kemikler, organlar ve iç boşluğu aynı sözlüksel dal altında sıralar.

concept_gloss.text: satır araları, kenar ve bedenin iç bölümleri
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca kitapta satır arası veya kenar, bedende kemik, organ ya da iç boşluk bildiren kayıtlı kullanımların ortak gösterimidir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bedenin yapısal parçalarının kemikler veya organlar olarak adlandırıldığı kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Bedenin kemik ve organlardan oluşan yapısal bölümleri korunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir erkeğin kendi bedeni zayıf olduğu için değil, bineği zayıf olduğu için özel bir biçimle nitelendiğini açıkça belirtir. Katılımcılar arasındaki bu ayrım dalın kurucu sınırıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nitelik görünüşte kişiye yönelse de zayıflığın taşıyıcısı onun bineğidir; kişinin kendi bedensel zayıflığı bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca kişiyi zayıf bineği üzerinden niteleyen kayıtlı söz öbeğine bağlıdır ve genel bir kişi ya da hayvan zayıflığına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir erkeği, kendi bedeni değil bineği zayıf olduğu için niteleyen söz öbeğidir.

facets.statement: Nitelenen kişi erkektir, fakat zayıflık kişiye değil onun bineğine aittir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kayıt, kişinin bedensel zayıflığı ile bineğinin zayıflığını ayırır ve özel nitelemeyi yalnızca ikinci duruma bağlar.

concept_gloss.text: bineği zayıf adam
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir erkeğin kendi gücü hakkında yargı vermeden, yalnızca zayıf bir bineğe sahip olduğunu bildiren özel nitelemede kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişi ile zayıflığın gerçek taşıyıcısı olan binek arasındaki katılımcı ayrımı korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiyi, kendisine ait bineğin güçsüzlüğünü öne çıkararak anlatan cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nitelemenin kişiye yönelmesi ve zayıflığın bineğe ait olması birlikte korunur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bineği zayıf adam

error_profile.loses: Zayıflığın kişinin bineğine ait olduğu kurucu katılımcı ayrımını kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Kişinin kendi bedeninin veya gücünün zayıf olduğu yorumunu getirir.
error_profile.collision: Yaygın okuma, kaynakta özellikle dışlanan kişisel bedensel zayıflıkla çakışır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin nitelenme nedeni mülklerinin çok ve dağınık olmasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca kişiyi çok ve dağınık mülkleri üzerinden niteleyen kayıtlı söz öbeğine bağlıdır; genel çoğalma, yayılma veya zenginlik anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide, davranışta ya da şeyde kendi alanına göre bulunan övgüye değer üstünlük; insanda eli açıklık, bağışlayıcılık ve utanç verici olandan uzak durma biçiminde belirir. Başkasını onurlandırma ve ona küçültücü olmayan değerli bir yarar ulaştırma da bu anlam alanına girer.

facets.statement: Kişi, davranış veya şey kendi alanında üstün ve övgüye değer sayılır.
İnsandaki çekirdek görünüm eli açıklık, bol iyilik, bağışlayıcılık ve güzel huydur.
Başkasını onurlandırmak veya ona incitmeden değerli bir yarar sağlamak bu niteliğin eylemsel uzantısıdır.
Kişinin kendisini ayıp ve utanç verici işlerden uzak tutması, kendi değerini koruyan bir tutum olarak anlatılır.
Övgüye değer çocuklar dünyaya getirmek veya değerli bir bağ ya da varlık edinmek bu geniş niteliğin özel örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, övgüye değer üstünlük ile eli açıklık ve güzel huy çekirdeğinde birleşir; bağışlama, ayıptan kaçınma ve başkasını onurlandırma bu çekirdeğin başlıca görünümleridir. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı üzüm, asma ve tek asma sürgünü üzerinden açıklar; tanelerin dizili kümelenmesi ve ağacın ya da meyvenin değerli görülmesi de adlandırma açıklamalarıdır. Verilen dal bu bitki ve meyve kapsamını doğru biçimde karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal üzüm, asma ve tek sürgün kapsamındadır; kolye anlamıyla yalnızca dizili kümelenme açıklamasında benzerlik kurulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın üzüm ve asma adını korur; özel bir söz kalıbından türetilmiş daha geniş bir anlam eklemez.

concept_map.definition: Üzüm meyvesi, bu meyveyi veren asma ve tek bir asma sürgünüdür.

facets.statement: Ad, üzüm meyvesini ve üzüm veren asmayı kapsar.
Tekil bitki parçası kullanımında bir asma sürgününü veya tek asmayı belirtir.
Tanelerin dallanmış bir kümede dizili oluşu ve asma ile meyvesinin değerli sayılması adlandırma gerekçeleri olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar üzüm ve asma anlamında birleşir; tek asma sürgünü ayrıca belirtilir, kümelenmiş taneler ile bitkinin değerli görülmesi de adın açıklaması olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.text: üzüm ve asma

error_profile.preserves: Üzüm meyvesi ile asma bitkisi arasındaki çift kapsamı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün meyveyi veya üzüm tanelerini belirttiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dalın meyve kapsamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Meyve ve asma alanında büyük ölçüde örtüşürler; komşunun dilbilgisel türevleri ile çok üzümü olan kişi kapsamı odak dalda yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bütün ağaç meyvelerini, meyvenin oluşmasını ve olgunlaşmasını genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Üzüm, genel meyve alanının bir üyesi olduğu için dallar meyve kavramında kesişir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli biçimi testi veya tencere ağzına konan tabak olarak tanımlar. Verilen çerçeve bu somut kapatma işlevini doğru biçimde yansıtır.

facets.statement: Nesne, bir kabın üst açıklığını örten tabak biçimli kapaktır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: testi veya tencere ağzına konan tabak biçimli kapak

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi; kabın kendisi ile bağlama yoluyla kapatmayı gösteren iki ilişki nesnenin sınırını en iyi açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki aşamalı olarak, biriyle eli açıklık konusunda övünme yarışına girmeyi ve ardından onu bu konuda geçmeyi anlatır. Verilen dal kimliği hem yarışmayı hem de üstün gelme sonucunu doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel övünme veya genel onurlandırma değildir; eli açıklık alanındaki karşılıklı yarışma ve üstün gelmeyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca belirtilmiş eylem yapılarındaki karşılıklı övünme yarışı ve üstün gelme anlamını verir; yalın kök anlamına genişletmez.

Yarışın sonuç aşamasında bir kişi diğerini eli açıklık bakımından geçer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu anlam için birden çok kaynağın ortaklaştırılabileceği ayrı bir özet bulunmaz; dal tek bir sözlük tanıklığıyla sınırlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kabul edilen bir öneriye sevgi, memnuniyet ve karşıdakine değer verme ekleyen birkaç kalıp yanıt biçimi sunar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bunları kabul ve saygı bildiren sözler olarak doğru biçimde bir araya getirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel saygınlık veya genel onurlandırma değildir; bir öneri ya da isteğe verilen memnuniyetli kabul ve iyi dilek kalıplarıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kabul, memnuniyet ve değer verme bildiren belirtilmiş yanıt kalıplarına bağlıdır; yalın bir saygınlık anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir öneri veya isteği memnuniyetle kabul ederken karşıdakine sevgi, saygı ve değer verme de bildiren kalıplaşmış yanıttır.

facets.statement: Konuşan, öneriyi veya isteği olumlu biçimde kabul eder.
Kabul, karşıdakine sevgi, memnuniyet ve değer verme duygusuyla güçlendirilir.
Aynı işlev, karşıdakinin kendisi veya gözü için değer bildiren çeşitli kalıp biçimlerle söylenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu sözleri olumlu kabulü sevgi ve değer verme duygusuyla güçlendiren yanıtlar olarak birleştirir; birden çok kalıp biçim aynı işlevi taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir yanda kişiye çok değerli gelen herhangi bir kişi veya şeyi, öte yanda bir topluluğun soylu ve seçkin temsilcisini anlatır. Verilen değerli kişi çerçevesi kullanılabilir, ancak nesneleri de kapsayan ilk kullanımla topluluğun seçkin kişisini anlatan ikinci kullanımın ayrılması gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca insanı anlatmaz; değer verilen bir şey de kapsama girebilir, topluluk kullanımı ise özellikle soylu ve seçkin kişiye bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kişiye değerli gelen kişi veya şey kullanımını topluluğun seçkin kişisi yapısından ayırır ve bu yapılardan bağımsız yalın bir anlam varsaymaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin gözünde çok değerli olan herhangi bir kişi veya şey ya da bir topluluğun soylu, saygın ve seçkin temsilcisidir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya şey, sahibi ya da ilgilisi için vazgeçilmesi zor derecede değerli olabilir.
Değer verilen kimse uğruna, kişinin değerli bulduğu başka şeyleri esirgememesi beklenebilir.
Topluluk yapısında söz, o topluluğun soylu, saygın ve seçkin kişisini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için ortaklaştırılacak çok kaynaklı bir açıklama yoktur; değer verilen varlık ve topluluğun seçkin kişisi kullanımları tek sözlükte tanıklanır.

source_details.summary: Kişiye çok değerli gelen kişi veya şey ile bir topluluğun soylu ve seçkin temsilcisi iki bağlı kullanım olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişisel olarak değer verilen kişi veya şeyi ve topluluk içindeki soylu temsilciyi birlikte açıklayan üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişi ya da şey kapsamını, yüksek değeri ve topluluk içindeki seçkinlik kullanımını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Değer veren kişiyi ve değer verilen kişi ya da şey kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğu temsil eden, soyu ve saygınlığıyla öne çıkan kişi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk bağını, soyluluğu ve seçkinliği korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, sahibine değerli gelen tekil kişi ya da şeyi ve topluluğun soylu temsilcisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir topluluk veya nesne grubunun seçkinleri, önde gelenleri ve geride kalan seçilmiş bölümü gibi çoğul kümeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal topluluk içinden seçkin ve üstün sayılan kişi alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu, seçkinlerden oluşan grup veya seçilmiş bölüm kavramına uzanır; odak dal kişisel değer ilişkisine ve tek bir soylu temsilciye bağlıdır.
